library(shiny)

```{r}
#| context: setup
# Load the  data
SLS <- read_csv("slslfsflowmean.csv") %>% mutate(towNum = 1)
mm20 <- read_csv("mm20lfsflowmean.csv") 

# Combine and Clean
month_order <- c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug")
station_order <- c("340","341", "342", "343", "344", "345", "346", "347", "348", "349")

water_year <- data.frame(
  wy = c(1995:2026),
  yearType = c("W","W","W","W","W","AN","D","D","AN","BN","AN","W","D","C","D", "BN", "W", "BN", "D", "C", "C", "BN", "W", "BN","W", "D", "C", "C", "W", "AN", "AN", "AN")  
)

all_data <- bind_rows(SLS, mm20) %>%
  mutate(
    date = mdy(date),
    wy = as.integer(wy),
    month = factor(month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE), levels = month_order),
    survey_label = paste(source, survey),
    station = as.character(station),
    count = as.integer(count),
    survey = as.integer(survey)
  ) %>%
  mutate(survey_label = fct_reorder(survey_label, date, .fun = min)) %>%
  left_join(water_year, by = "wy")

# 1. Define Region Order and Colors
region_order <- c(
  "Central & South Delta", 
  "Sacramento River System", 
  "Confluence",
  "Suisun Bay & Marsh",
  "Napa River",
  "San Pablo & Carquinez Strait"
)

region_colors <- c(
  "San Pablo & Carquinez Strait"        = "#80b1d3", 
  "Napa River"                          = "#bebada", 
  "Suisun Bay & Marsh"                  = "#fdb462", 
  "Confluence"                          = "#ffffb3", 
  "Sacramento River System"             = "#fb8072", 
  "Central & South Delta"               = "#8dd3c7"
)

```


##  {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectizeInput(
  "years", "Select Water Year(s):", 
  choices = c("ALL", sort(unique(all_data$wy), decreasing = TRUE)),
  selected = "ALL",
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))
)
hr()
selectizeInput(
  "regions", "Select Region(s):", 
  choices = c("ALL", sort(unique(all_data$oldregionupdate))),
  selected = "Napa River",
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))
)
hr()
checkboxGroupInput(
  "source", "Project:",
  choices = c("20mm", "SLS"),
  selected = c("20mm", "SLS"),
  inline = TRUE
)
hr()
uiOutput("survey_ui")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# This ensures SLS 12/13 (December) come before SLS 1 (January)
sls_custom_order <- c("SLS 12", "SLS 13", "SLS 1", "SLS 2", "SLS 3", "SLS 4", "SLS 5", "SLS 6")

# --- 2. DYNAMIC TWO-COLUMN SURVEY UI ---
output$survey_ui <- renderUI({
  # Filter data based on selected Regions to get relevant survey choices
  region_data <- if("ALL" %in% input$regions) all_data else all_data %>% filter(oldregionupdate %in% input$regions)
  
  choices_20mm <- region_data %>% filter(source == "20mm") %>% pull(survey_label) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  raw_sls <- region_data %>% filter(source == "SLS") %>% pull(survey_label) %>% unique()
  choices_sls <- intersect(sls_custom_order, raw_sls)
  choices_sls <- c(choices_sls, setdiff(raw_sls, sls_custom_order))
  
  tagList(
    tags$label(tags$strong("Select Surveys:")),
    fluidRow(
      column(6, 
        if ("20mm" %in% input$source) {
          tagList(
            tags$small(actionLink("all_20", "All"), " | ", actionLink("none_20", "None")),
            checkboxGroupInput("surveys_20mm", "20mm", choices = choices_20mm, selected = choices_20mm)
          )
        }
      ),
      column(6, 
        if ("SLS" %in% input$source) {
          tagList(
            tags$small(actionLink("all_sls", "All"), " | ", actionLink("none_sls", "None")),
            checkboxGroupInput("surveys_sls", "SLS", choices = choices_sls, selected = choices_sls)
          )
        }
      )
    )
  )
})

# --- 3. ALL/NONE LOGIC ---
observeEvent(input$all_20, {
  region_data <- if("ALL" %in% input$regions) all_data else all_data %>% filter(oldregionupdate %in% input$regions)
  choices <- region_data %>% filter(source == "20mm") %>% pull(survey_label) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "surveys_20mm", selected = choices)
})
observeEvent(input$none_20, { updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "surveys_20mm", selected = character(0)) })

observeEvent(input$all_sls, {
  region_data <- if("ALL" %in% input$regions) all_data else all_data %>% filter(oldregionupdate %in% input$regions)
  raw_sls <- region_data %>% filter(source == "SLS") %>% pull(survey_label) %>% unique()
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "surveys_sls", selected = intersect(sls_custom_order, raw_sls))
})
observeEvent(input$none_sls, { updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "surveys_sls", selected = character(0)) })

# --- 4. REACTIVE DATASET (Updated for Regions) ---
all_r <- reactive({
  selected_surveys <- c(input$surveys_20mm, input$surveys_sls)
  
  if (is.null(input$years) || is.null(input$source) || is.null(input$regions) || length(selected_surveys) == 0) {
    return(all_data[0, ])
  }
  
  df <- all_data
  
  if (!"ALL" %in% input$years) df <- df %>% filter(wy %in% input$years)
  if (!"ALL" %in% input$regions) df <- df %>% filter(oldregionupdate %in% input$regions)
  
  df %>% filter(source %in% input$source, survey_label %in% selected_surveys)
})

# --- 5. VALUE BOXES ---
output$stat_tows <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  total <- nrow(data)
  sls_val <- sum(data$source == "SLS")
  mm_val  <- sum(data$source == "20mm")
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Tows", style = "text-align: center;"),
     value = div(format(total, big.mark = ","), style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", format(sls_val, big.mark = ","), " | 20mm: ", format(mm_val, big.mark = ",")), style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em;"),
     theme = "primary"
  )
})

output$stat_surveys <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(value_box("Total Surveys", 0, theme = "secondary"))
  
  total <- data %>% select(wy, source, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  # Define values locally specifically for survey counts
  sls_val <- data %>% filter(source == "SLS") %>% select(wy, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  mm_val  <- data %>% filter(source == "20mm") %>% select(wy, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Surveys", style = "text-align: center;"),
    value = div(total, style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", sls_val, " | 20mm: ", mm_val), style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em; opacity: 0.9;"),
    theme = "secondary"
  )
})

output$stat_fish <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  total <- sum(data$count, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Define values locally specifically for fish counts
  sls_val <- sum(data$count[data$source == "SLS"], na.rm = TRUE)
  mm_val  <- sum(data$count[data$source == "20mm"], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Longfin Smelt", style = "text-align: center;"),
    value = div(format(total, big.mark = ","), style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", format(sls_val, big.mark = ","), " | 20mm: ", format(mm_val, big.mark = ",")), 
      style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em; opacity: 0.9;"),
    theme = "info"
  )
})
output$effort_table <- renderDT({
  df <- all_r()
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(datatable(data.frame(Status = "No Data Selected"), dom = 't', rownames = FALSE))
  }

  eff_wide <- df %>%
    group_by(oldregionupdate, station, wy) %>%
    summarise(Tows = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(Tows = as.character(Tows)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = wy, values_from = Tows, values_fill = "") %>%
    arrange(oldregionupdate, desc(station)) %>%
    select(-oldregionupdate)
  
  datatable(
    eff_wide, 
    extensions = 'FixedColumns', # 1. Add the FixedColumns extension
    options = list(
      dom = 't', 
      paging = FALSE, 
      scrollX = TRUE,            # 2. REQUIRED for FixedColumns
      scrollY = "490px",         # 3. REQUIRED to pin the Header
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 1), # 4. Freeze the 1st column (Station)
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"),
        # Set a specific width for the station column so it looks clean when frozen
        list(width = '80px', targets = 0) 
      )
    ), 
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = "Number of Tows per Station by Water Year "
  )
})

output$catch_plot_faceted <- renderPlotly({
  data <- all_r() 
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)

  # 1. Determine if we are in "Single Year Mode" 
  is_single_year <- length(input$years) == 1 && !("ALL" %in% input$years)
  
  # 2. Setup the Plot Data
  if (is_single_year) {
    # Define Survey Sort Orders (Using your custom order for SLS)
    sls_levels <- c("SLS 12", "SLS 13", "SLS 1", "SLS 2", "SLS 3", "SLS 4", "SLS 5", "SLS 6")
    mm_levels <- paste("20mm", 1:10)
    
    plot_data <- data %>%
      mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm"))) %>%
      mutate(x_axis = factor(survey_label, levels = c(sls_levels, mm_levels))) %>%
      group_by(x_axis, source, oldregionupdate) %>% 
      summarise(RegionalCatch = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(oldregionupdate = factor(oldregionupdate, levels = region_order))
    
    x_label <- "Survey"
    # FIXED: Use "free" so Y-axis and X-axis are independent for each project
    facet_scales <- "free" 
    
  } else {
    # MULTI-YEAR MODE
    plot_data <- data %>%
      mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm"))) %>%
      mutate(x_axis = factor(wy)) %>% 
      group_by(x_axis, wy, source, oldregionupdate, yearType) %>% 
      summarise(RegionalCatch = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(oldregionupdate = factor(oldregionupdate, levels = region_order))
    
    x_label <- "Water Year"
    facet_scales <- "free_y"
    
    # Calculate totals for labels
    year_totals <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(x_axis, source, yearType) %>% 
      summarise(AnnualTotal = sum(RegionalCatch), .groups = "drop")
  }

  # 3. Define the single-row key text
  wy_legend_text <- "<b>W:</b> Wet | <b>AN:</b> Above Normal | <b>BN:</b> Below Normal | <b>D:</b> Dry | <b>C:</b> Critical"

  # 4. Create the Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_axis, y = RegionalCatch)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = oldregionupdate), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    
    # Year type labels (Only added if NOT single year)
    { if(!is_single_year) geom_text(data = year_totals, 
                                    aes(x = x_axis, y = AnnualTotal, label = paste0(yearType, "\n")), 
                                    vjust = 0.2, size = 3, fontface = "bold") } +
    
    facet_wrap(~source, ncol = 1, scales = facet_scales) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Total Catch") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(2.5, "lines"), 
      # FIXED: Move X-axis title lower using margin
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
    )

  # 5. Convert to plotly and adjust layout
  ggplotly(p) %>% 
    layout(
      margin = list(t = 60, b = 130), # Increased bottom margin for label + legend
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.26),
      # Add the WY Type Key ONLY in multi-year mode
      annotations = if(!is_single_year) {
        list(list(
          x = 0.5, y = -0.22, 
          text = wy_legend_text,
          showarrow = FALSE,
          xref = 'paper', yref = 'paper',
          xanchor = 'center', yanchor = 'bottom',
          font = list(size = 11)
        ))
      } else { list() }
    )
})

```
